objection_responses.data_privacy: We deploy 100% inside your dedicated VPC or private cloud environment. Zero client data or embeddings ever leave your infrastructure.
objection_responses.hallucinations: We implement multi-step guardrails and citation verification—if a query cannot be verified against retrieved ground-truth documents, the system explicitly returns an unverified status.
objection_responses.internal_team: We provide your engineers with full source code, Terraform scripts, and CI/CD pipelines so your team owns and maintains the architecture.
objection_responses.no_budget: Our feasibility prototype is $18,500 and establishes full benchmark metrics within 14 days.
objection_responses.model_lock_in: Our architecture is model-agnostic, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, or local open-weights models (Llama 3 / Mistral) interchangeably via an abstracted API.
